title: Indian Trio Wins 50m Pistol Team Gold at ISSF World Championship
excerpt: Ravinder Singh, Saurabh Chaudhary and Amanpreet Singh combined for 1,659 points in Doha, and the women's air rifle team added a silver on India's opening medal day.
body:
• Ravinder Singh, Saurabh Chaudhary and Amanpreet Singh won the men's 50m pistol team gold at the ISSF World Championship in Doha with a combined 1,659 points.
  • Ravinder also took individual silver in the 50m pistol with 559, two points behind neutral athlete Anton Aristarkhov.
  • Elavenil Valarivan, Sonam Uttam Maskar and Shambhavi Shravan Kshirsagar won silver in the women's 10m air rifle team event with 1,894.4 points.
  • India finished the day second in the medal standings with one gold and two silvers, but missed the LA 2028 Olympic quotas on offer in the 10m air rifle events.

India opened its medal account at the ISSF World Championship in Doha on Tuesday with a gold and two silvers, led by the men's 50m pistol team of Ravinder Singh, Saurabh Chaudhary and Amanpreet Singh.

The trio combined for 1,659 points to take the team title at the Lusail Shooting Complex. Ravinder led the Indian scoring with 559, including 11 inner 10s, ahead of Saurabh Chaudhary's 551 and Amanpreet Singh's 549. China took silver with 1,648 points through Zhang Bingchen, Lyu Junyi and Feng Linlang, and South Korea claimed bronze with 1,643.

"India opened its medal account at the ISSF World Championship in Doha on Tuesday with a gold and two silvers, led by the men's 50m pistol team of Ravinder Singh, Saurabh Chaudhary and Amanpreet Singh."

Ravinder doubles up in the individual event

Ravinder added an individual silver in the same discipline, his 559 finishing two points behind Anton Aristarkhov, who won gold with 561 competing as a neutral athlete. Romania's Luca Joldea took bronze with 558. The men's 50m pistol is not part of the Olympic programme, so no quota places were attached to the result.

Silver for the women's air rifle team

India's second silver came in the women's 10m air rifle team event, where Elavenil Valarivan, Sonam Uttam Maskar and Shambhavi Shravan Kshirsagar aggregated 1,894.4 points. China won gold with 1,899.8 and Japan took bronze with 1,892.6. Elavenil was the strongest Indian qualifier with 634.2, followed by Sonam's 630.5 and Shambhavi's 629.7.

Elavenil reached the individual final after qualifying third, but finished sixth and missed an LA 2028 Olympic quota. In the men's 10m air rifle, Rakesh Mane, Himanshu Dhillon and Paarth Makhija did not reach the team or individual finals.

What it means

India sits second in the medal standings with one gold and two silver medals, behind China, which leads with five medals including three golds. The championships, running in Doha until November 14, are the first qualification event of the LA 2028 cycle, with 36 Olympic quota places available across the 12 individual Olympic events.
